Stuart Jackson is Co-Founder and Chief Financial Officer (Crunchbase, Board Intelligence interview). James Eddison is Co-Founder and CTO. Octopus Energy Group release, 1 Sep 2026 (Houston / Boulder): Octopus Energy has closed its investment in Uplight, which continues as an independent company; Schneider Electric, an existing investor, continues its backing alongside Octopus's new majority stake; Nick Chaset is named CEO of Uplight alongside his role as CEO of Octopus Energy US; targets of $1 billion in customer savings and more than doubling flexible capacity to 20 GW over five years; Uplight manages 8.5 GW of flexible load across more than 85 utilities including eight of the ten largest in the US. Definitive agreement announced 24 Mar 2026 (Uplight press page). Secondary: Renewable Energy Magazine, 4 Sep 2026; Daily Energy Insider.

Octopus Energy release, 7 May 2024: valuation rises 15% on the last round to $9 billion (£7.2bn) as Generation Investment Management (now 13% of the group) and CPP Investments (now 12%) increase their stakes. Also carried by Generation IM's newsroom and UKTN.

CNBC, 30 Dec 2025, and Sifted / Ontario Teachers' release: Octopus Energy Group to spin out Kraken after a $1 billion round at an $8.65 billion valuation led by D1 Capital Partners with Fidelity International, Durable Capital Partners and Ontario Teachers'; $850 million of the proceeds go to Octopus and $150 million to Kraken; Origin Energy (22.7% of Octopus) invests $140 million; Octopus will retain 13.7% of Kraken; separation targeted by mid-2026 (completion not yet confirmed as of 5 Sep 2026). Tokyo Gas and Origin are long-standing Octopus investors (TechCrunch 2020; Canary Media 2023).

Sifted on the filed FY25 annual report (year to 30 April 2025): revenue £13.7bn, up 10% from £12.4bn; 10 million customers globally, 7.6m UK homes (24% share), 2.4m international; net loss £255m after one-off items (Bulb acquisition costs, final Energy Price Guarantee settlement); £1.5bn net assets. The annual report itself is filed at octopusenergy.group.

Arsenal.com and the Octopus Group newsroom: Octopus Energy has been Arsenal's official energy partner since October 2016 under a long-term deal; the Emirates Stadium and training facilities run on renewable supply, fans are offered a matching tariff, and Octopus receives stadium branding, hospitality and access to club channels.

Octopus Energy release: Octopus Electroverse connects drivers to more than 1 million public EV chargers in over 40 countries, Europe's largest consumer charging platform.

Octopus Energy's Intelligent Octopus Go page, citing Ofgem's State of the Market report: 653,000 domestic customers were on a smart time-of-use EV tariff in July 2025, more than half of them with Octopus, most on Intelligent Octopus Go.
Octopus Energy US press page (Houston): Octopus Energy US is a Texas retail electricity provider led by CEO Nick Chaset; the 1 Sep 2026 Uplight release is datelined Houston and Boulder.

electrive, 3 Nov 2025: Jaguar presents its first new all-electric model in 2026 and starts taking orders, the first of three new electric Jaguars, sold through high-end sales centres including London's Bond Street; the reborn brand is electric-only (reported).

brief.industry_meta: Energy Retail & Technology · Renewable Supply, EV Charging, Grid Flexibility
brief.deck: Octopus Energy, Britain's largest household supplier with £13.7bn of revenue and 10 million customers, closed its majority investment in US grid-flexibility company Uplight on 1 September, eight months after selling a $1B stake in Kraken at $8.65B. The most EV-native energy brand has never been on an electric racing car.
brief.the_case_p1: On 1 September Octopus Energy Group completed its majority investment in Uplight, which manages 8.5 GW of flexible load for more than 85 US utilities; Schneider Electric stays as minority partner and Nick Chaset runs Uplight alongside Octopus Energy US. It caps a year of capital re-shaping: $850M of the $1B Kraken stake sale (December 2025, $8.65B valuation) went to Octopus, on top of a $9B valuation set by Generation Investment Management and CPP Investments in May 2024. The year to 30 April 2025 brought £13.7bn of revenue, up 10%, and 10 million customers.
brief.the_case_p2: The brand is built on electric cars. Electroverse reaches more than 1 million public chargers in over 40 countries, Ford integrated it into its own charging network in September 2025, and more than half of Britain's 653,000 smart EV-tariff customers are with Octopus. It already knows long-term sport: Arsenal's official energy partner since October 2016. What it lacks is a stage where the product is the sport itself.
brief.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The Uplight close on 1 September and the Kraken separation give Octopus a new group story to tell, and cash to tell it. Formula E's Season 13 opens in Jeddah on 18 December; a partner signed in the fourth quarter is on the car for the London E-Prix in May 2027.
brief.why_team_para: Jaguar TCS Racing carries TCS as title and technology partner, Castrol and the Jaguar powertrain; there is no energy retailer, EV-charging or home-energy brand on the roster. The road brand relaunches electric-only in 2026 with its first new car sold from Bond Street, so every new owner needs a tariff and a charging network. Two British electrification brands, one home race in London, and a team that runs its technology partners through the garage.
brief.value_content: MODE A - operational. Renewable supply and Electroverse roaming for the team's UK operations and road fleet, with Octopus's flexibility analytics applied to race-weekend energy use. The larger workstream is commercial: an Intelligent Octopus Go plus Electroverse bundle for buyers of the new electric Jaguars, on the model Ford adopted in 2025. Return: a category partner, London hospitality for millions of customers, and content putting charging in the racing story.
brief.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Energy Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, Seasons 13-15, matching the GEN4 cycle and Jaguar's electric relaunch. Estimated £1.5-3M a season, part-payable in supply and charging services. Scope: car and suit placement, tariff and charging integration for Jaguar customers, London E-Prix hospitality and sustainability reporting.
brief.decision_maker_bio: Jackson founded Octopus in 2015 and fronts its partnerships and investors. Path: Rebecca Dibb-Simkin, Chief Product and Marketing Officer, who owns the brand; Stuart Jackson, Co-Founder and CFO; Nick Chaset for any US extension. No separate CMO title.
brief.opening_angle_quote: “Greg, Octopus has more electric-car customers than anyone in Britain and Jaguar is about to relaunch electric-only; the energy lane on its Formula E car is open and Arsenal proved the model works for you. 25 minutes before the Jeddah opener to map it?”

why_now.label: Trigger
why_now.text: Octopus Energy Group completed its majority investment in Uplight on 1 September 2026. Uplight stays an independent company, Schneider Electric remains a minority partner, and Nick Chaset becomes Uplight's CEO alongside his role running Octopus Energy US. The stated targets are $1 billion of customer savings and more than doubling flexible capacity to 20 GW over five years.

why_now.label: A year of capital re-shaping
why_now.text: In December 2025 Octopus sold a $1B stake in Kraken at an $8.65B valuation, with $850M of the proceeds going to the group, and set a mid-2026 target for full separation. The group itself was valued at $9B in May 2024 when Generation Investment Management and CPP Investments increased their stakes. A company that has just re-cut its own identity needs a new way to explain itself to customers and investors.

why_now.label: The numbers underneath
why_now.text: In the year to 30 April 2025 Octopus recorded £13.7bn of revenue, up 10%, and grew to 10 million customers, including 7.6m UK homes. It reported a £255m net loss after one-off items, which is why the brief sizes the entry at partner level and includes an in-kind supply component.

why_now.label: Calendar window
why_now.text: Formula E's Season 13 opens in Jeddah on 18 December 2026 and reaches London on 29-30 May 2027. A partnership agreed in the fourth quarter is announced at the season launch and activated in full at the home race.

why_team.label: The open lane
why_team.text: Jaguar TCS Racing carries TCS as title and technology partner, Castrol and the Jaguar powertrain. There is no energy retailer, EV-charging or home-energy brand on the roster, so Official Energy Partner is a clean category at a team-partner price.

why_team.label: Jaguar's relaunch
why_team.text: The road brand is relaunching electric-only in 2026 with its first new car sold from Bond Street, the first of three new electric Jaguars. Every buyer needs a home tariff and a public charging network; Octopus sells both, and Ford has already shown that an OEM will integrate Electroverse into its own charging offer.

why_team.label: Two British electrification stories
why_team.text: Britain's largest household supplier and Britain's electric racing team, with a home race in London. The partnership reads as a national story rather than a badge.

why_team.label: A team that uses its partners
why_team.text: The TCS partnership runs across the team's operations rather than sitting on the car. Octopus's supply, charging and flexibility products fit the same pattern.

value.label: Operational workstream (Mode A)
value.text: Renewable supply and Electroverse roaming for the team's UK operations and road fleet, and the flexibility analytics Octopus sells to utilities applied to the team's race-weekend energy use and reporting.

value.label: Commercial workstream for the parent
value.text: An Intelligent Octopus Go plus Electroverse bundle offered to buyers of the new electric Jaguars in the UK, on the model Ford adopted in September 2025, giving the team's parent a customer proposition and Octopus a premium acquisition channel.

value.label: Commercial lift for the team
value.text: A consumer brand with 10 million customers brings a mass audience to the London E-Prix and a hospitality guest list of fleet, utility and government buyers. The Arsenal partnership shows Octopus activates for a decade, not a season.

value.label: What the team gives back
value.text: Official Energy Partner designation, car and race-suit placement, London E-Prix hospitality, driver access for Octopus's channels, and co-produced content on charging and grid flexibility.
